name: Translational Science 2027
organizer: Association for Clinical and Translational Science
description: The Association for Clinical and Translational Science holds Translational Science 2027 in Washington, DC. The meeting is in person only and covers clinical and translational research methods and infrastructure.

sources.note: Confirms April 20 to 23, 2027, Washington DC, and that the meeting will be in person only
Confirms scientific session and poster proposals are open, but no closing date was visible in the accessible content

notes: Session and poster proposal submissions are open as of the research date but no specific closing date could be confirmed on accessible pages; check actscience.org/Call-for-Proposals directly for the current deadline.
